record.nameMeaning: "Terrible claw", for the sickle claw on its foot
record.oneLiner: The sickle-clawed raptor that sparked the 'dinosaur renaissance'.
record.description: Deinonychus was a dromaeosaurid theropod up to about 3.4 m long from the Cretaceous of North America, bearing an enlarged, sickle-shaped killing claw on each foot. John Ostrom's study of it in the 1960s revolutionised views of dinosaurs as active, agile, possibly warm-blooded animals — igniting the 'dinosaur renaissance'.

notableFacts.text: Its enlarged sickle-shaped foot claw gives it its name, 'terrible claw'.
Ostrom's 1960s study of it sparked the 'dinosaur renaissance'.
The real-life basis for the 'raptors' of Jurassic Park, which used the name Velociraptor.
